title: SGA: Working Translation, Source-Repair, and Audit Drafts (Reader-First Public Surface)
description:
This is the reader-facing SGA working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The July 2026 version replaces a 100-loose-file surface with front readers and grouped ZIPs: current SGA5 French workpass, current SGA6 French source-rescribe workpass, an SGA6 English unsynchronized working draft, and grouped TeX/audit/source-support bundles.

Open first: 00_SGA5_French_Workpass_NotCertified_20260706.pdf, 01_SGA6_French_SourceRescribe_Workpass_NotCertified_20260706.pdf, and 02_SGA6_English_Unsynced_WorkingDraft_repair108_20260622.pdf. The ZIP files contain the editable TeX, audit ledgers, errata, method notes, and source-support packages.

Status: this is useful source-aware working material, not OCR-only, but it is not a critical edition and not a globally certified complete SGA corpus. SGA5 is explicitly not complete and remains known to contain mathematical/source-fidelity errors outside audited loci. SGA6 has substantial source-rescribe work but still needs care around diagrams, labels, compression artifacts, and English synchronization.

Older granular repair packets and reference-file surfaces remain preserved in previous Zenodo versions. Corrections can be proposed through the GitHub mirror: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first cleanup version. This version deliberately groups TeX/audit/source-support materials into ZIPs and fronts current PDFs. It does not certify SGA5 or SGA6 as critical editions.
